title: 第1920章 世子女好似一根刺扎得皇帝难受第1919章 璐王过世宋安许王位之路艰难
content_zh:
接连数天都没有消息，许长史坐不住了。
他又不知道找谁商量。
昔日同窗同年同乡，各有前程。留在京城的多是中下层官员，消息说不定还没他灵通。宗正寺那边倒是认识几个人，却都做不了主，属于老黄牛那一类的人。
礼部那边，倒是有一个同乡，奈何位卑言轻。
数来数去，全都帮不上忙，着实心酸。
下面的人见他烦恼，于是给他出主意，“大人何不找陈狱丞商量。他背靠侯府，陈皇后跟他是本家。要说消息灵通，又有几人比得上他。”
“他？能成吗？”
“大人可能不太了解，传闻，先帝过世的时候，他就在宫里。两位公子的那份旨意，传闻也是他求来的。”
建始帝过世的时候，陈观楼问对方要了一份旨意，替两个儿子正名。以免有人拿两个孩子的身世做文章。
亏他想的周到。
如今璐王过世，无论是璐王府一脉宗亲，还是宫里头，只是质疑宋安许身为女子的身份，无人胆敢质疑两个孩子的身份。也没有人胆敢拿两个孩子的身世做文章。
先帝亲自做保，质疑孩子的身世，就是在质疑先帝。
许长史闻言，暗自点头。既然找不到门路，那就跟陈狱丞聊聊。就算起不了作用，好歹能缓解一下焦虑。
此次见面很正式。
许长史递上名帖，陈观楼定了时间，两人就在陈家小院见面。
胡管家吩咐厨房置办了一桌酒菜，两人就着酒菜闲聊家常。
“许长史是哪一年去的王府。上回我去王府没见过你。”陈观楼打听对方的来历。
“本官是元鼎元年去的王府。前任长史过世，我接了位置。”
陈观楼了然一笑，“听闻许大人是吴洲人？”
“正是。”

“吴洲好地方啊，离璐王封地也不远。此次璐王过世，王妃和世子女派你进京，想来对你极为认可。”
“陈狱丞客气了。本官也只是尽量为王妃以及世子女还有两位小公子分忧。”
“甚好！”
陈观楼脸上一直挂着笑容，“听闻，事情不太顺利？”
许长史心头一跳，“确实不太顺利。不知陈狱丞这边可有消息？”
陈观楼吃了一颗花生米，咬得嘎嘣脆。
他问了一句，“许大人对皇帝了解几分？”
许长史摇头，表示完全不了解。
陈观楼继续说下去，“皇帝这个人，最大的特点就是心胸狭窄，不能容人。”
许长史顿时坐立不安，感觉屁股下面有钉子。就这么大喇喇的议论皇帝，合适吗？真不怕传出去，惹来祸事。
陈观楼了然一笑，“许大人不必惊慌，我们之间的聊天，不会有第三人知道。”
content_en:
There was no news for several days, and Xu Changshi couldn't sit still.
He didn't know who to consult with.
We were classmates in the same year and from the same hometown, each with his own future. Most of the people who stayed in the capital were middle- and lower-level officials, and the news might not be as well-informed as him. I do know a few people at Zongzheng Temple, but none of them can make the decision. They are like old scalpers.
On the other side of the Ministry of Rites, there is a fellow countryman, but he has a humble position.
I counted over and over again, but none of them were of help, which was really sad.
The people below saw that he was troubled, so they gave him some advice, "Your Excellency, why don't you discuss it with Chen Yuucheng. He is backed by the Hou Mansion, and Queen Chen is from his family. When it comes to being well-informed, there are a few people who can match him."
"He? Can it happen?"
"Your Excellency may not know much about it. Rumor has it that he was in the palace when the late emperor passed away. Rumor has it that he also asked for the wishes of the two young masters."
When Emperor Jianshi passed away, Chen Guanlou asked him for a decree to clear the names of his two sons. Lest anyone make a fuss about the lives of the two children.
Thank you for his thoughtfulness.
Now that King Lu has passed away, no one in the royal family or in the palace only questions Song Anxu's identity as a woman, and no one dares to question the identity of the two children. No one dared to make a fuss about the life experiences of the two children.
The late emperor personally acted as guarantee. To question the child's life experience is to question the late emperor.
When Xu Changshi heard this, he nodded secretly. Since you can't find a way out, let's talk to Chen Yuucheng. Even if it doesn't work, it can at least relieve the anxiety.
This meeting was very formal.
Xu Changshi handed over the name card, Chen Guanlou set a time, and the two met in the Chen family courtyard.
Butler Hu ordered the kitchen to set up a table of wine and food, and the two of them chatted about home affairs over the wine and food.
"In what year did Xu Changshi go to the palace? I didn't see you last time I went to the palace." Chen Guanlou asked about the other party's origins.
"I am the prince who went to the palace in the first year of Yuanding. The previous chief history passed away, and I took over the position."
Chen Guanlou smiled clearly, "I heard that Mr. Xu is from Wuzhou?"
"Exactly."
"Wuzhou is a great place. It's not far from King Lu's fiefdom. This time King Lu passed away, and the princess and her children sent you to the capital. I think they recognize you very much."
"Chen Yucheng is too polite. I just try my best to share the worries of the princess, the children and the two young gentlemen."
"Very good!"
Chen Guanlou always had a smile on his face, "I heard that things are not going well?"
Xu Changshi's heart skipped a beat, "It's indeed not going well. I wonder if there is any news from Chen Yuucheng?"
Chen Guanlou ate a peanut and it was crunchy.
He asked, "How much does Mr. Xu know about the emperor?"
Xu Changshi shook his head and said he didn't understand at all.
Chen Guanlou continued, "The biggest characteristic of the emperor is that he is narrow-minded and intolerant of others."
Xu Changshi suddenly became restless and felt like there were nails under his butt. Is it appropriate to talk about the emperor so loudly? I'm really not afraid of spreading the word and causing trouble.
Chen Guanlou smiled understandingly, "Master Xu, don't panic, no third party will know about our chat."
